name: Voltbyte
description: A robotic wolf that moves in multiples. It strikes fast and charges lightning in stages.
special_ability: Thunder Sequence: charge, afterimages, then a high-speed strike. Interrupt any stage!
defence_style: No shield - it relies on speed (an extra Quick Strike every other round).

abilities.name: Thunder Sequence
abilities.description: Three stages - interrupt it with multiplication or division.

stages.name: Charge Electricity
stages.text: Voltbyte charges electricity through its circuits!

stages.name: Electric Afterimages
stages.text: Voltbyte splits into crackling afterimages - it is about to strike!
